items.h: Jonathon Brooks (groin) listed questionable for Week 12
items.s: Jonathon Brooks is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Buccaneers. Brooks practiced in full this week. He'll have a chance to return from injured reserve to a depth role in the Panthers backfield.

Brooks (groin) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Buccaneers, Sheena Quick of Fox Sports Radio 1340 reports. Brooks was a full participant in all three practices during Week 12 prep, but he would need to be activated from injured reserve in order to be available for Monday's NFC South game. He's in the final stages of his recovery from core-muscle surgery that led to him being placed on IR in late September. If he's cleared to return, then Brooks would slot in as the Panthers' change-of-pace back behind Chuba Hubbard.

items.h: Jonathon Brooks Only Retains Handcuff Value If Activated
items.s: Carolina Panthers running back Jonathon Brooks (abdomen) hasn't played since Week 2 after being placed on the injured reserve. In his first two weeks, Brooks gathered a handful of touches each game, but was not particularly efficient outside of one long reception. Despite being a full participant every practice last week leading up to their Week 11 game, and head coach Dave Canales expressing that he believed Brooks was ready to play, he was not activated from the IR. Canales' reasoning was that the other backs in Carolina each play an important role, so there may not be space to activate Brooks to the roster. There is a chance that Brooks, currently listed as questionable, is activated…

Carolina Panthers running back Jonathon Brooks (abdomen), who remains on Injured Reserve, is officially questionable to play on Monday night against the division-rival Tampa Bay Buccaneers in Week 12, according to Sheena Quick. Brooks was a full participant in practice on Friday and has been nearing his return from a core-muscle injury in recent weeks, but the Panthers have admitted it has been tough to find a big enough role to justify activating the 23-year-old former second-rounder from Texas. We will know by Saturday afternoon's deadline if Brooks is officially activated from IR, and if he is activated, he figures to play a small change-of-pace role in Carolina's backfield behind…

Brooks (groin) practiced without limitations Friday. Brooks has shed any practice limitations, but he'll still need to be added back to the active roster to play Monday in Tampa Bay. Even if Brooks gets the green light to suit up and is activated by the Panthers, he'll likely have to settle for a change-of-pace role behind Chuba Hubbard against Tampa Bay's excellent run defense.

items.h: Jonathon Brooks (groin) logs full practice Thursday
items.s: Jonathon Brooks was a full participant in practice on Thursday. Brooks has a chance to be activated from injured reserve this week. He is likely to remain off the fantasy radar.

Brooks (groin) was estimated as a full practice participant on Thursday's report, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports. The Panthers didn't practice Thursday for Thanksgiving, so the report provided by the team was an estimation. Given that, Brooks' practice participation over the next two days will provide a better indication of his status heading into Monday's NFC South tilt against the Buccaneers. However, Brooks would need to be activated from injured reserve in order to be available for Week 12. The third-year running back landed on IR in late September after undergoing surgery to repair a core-muscle injury that he sustained against the Falcons in Week 2.

Head coach Dave Canales suggested Wednesday that a decision on Brooks (core) being activated from injured reserve before his 21-day window expires next week will hinge on the Panthers having a role available to him, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports. After having his window opened Nov. 11, Brooks was a limited practice participant throughout Week 10 before practicing fully for all three of the Panthers' Week 11 sessions. Brooks is poised to remain a full practice participant leading up to Monday's game at Tampa Bay, but he doesn't appear to be a lock to get activated from IR for that contest. Canales noted that Chuba Hubbard has thrived of late as the Panthers' lead back, while Trevor Etienne…

items.h: Jonathon Brooks Could Have Limited Role When Active
items.s: Carolina Panthers head coach Dave Canales admitted on Monday that Trevor Etienne's and Tre Tyus' special teams value is making it challenging to find a spot for running back Jonathon Brooks (groin) as he looks to come off Injured Reserve, according to Joe Person of The Athletic. Brooks' return-from-IR window is open for only another eight days, and if the Panthers do not activate him by then, he will be lost for the rest of the 2026 season. The 23-year-old was able to practice in full last week, but he was not activated to play in the Week 11 win over the Baltimore Ravens. Brooks was a popular post-hype sleeper this preseason despite already tearing his ACL twice in his NFL career, but he…

items.h: Jonathon Brooks Is a Deep-League Injured Reserve Stash
items.s: Carolina Panthers running back Jonathon Brooks (groin) is worth a Week 12 claim in deeper leagues if you have an open IR slot. He's rostered in 37% of Yahoo leagues. The Panthers opened his 21-day practice window on Nov. 11. He practiced fully last week and was listed as questionable Friday before Carolina kept him on injured reserve and ruled him out Saturday. Head coach Dave Canales said the team was weighing how to get Brooks onto the game-day roster with Chuba Hubbard handling the bulk of the carries and Trevor Etienne contributing as a returner. Hubbard took 27 of the backfield's 33 carries in Sunday's win over the Baltimore Ravens, and Etienne took the rest. Hubbard also led the…
Jonathon Brooks has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Ravens. Brooks will remain on IR for at least one more week.

Brooks (groin) has been downgraded to out for Sunday's game against the Ravens. Brooks was a full practice participant in all three sessions during Week 11 prep. However, the third-year running back is not quite ready to be activated from injured reserve, and he's slated to miss his eighth consecutive game while recovering from a groin injury. Trevor Etienne, Anthony Tyus and AJ Dillon will continue to operate as the Panthers' backfield depth options behind Chuba Hubbard in the absence of Brooks, whose next opportunity to play is Week 12 against the Buccaneers on Monday, Nov. 30.

items.h: Jonathon Brooks Downgraded to Out Against Ravens
items.s: Carolina Panthers running back Jonathon Brooks (groin) will miss Sunday's Week 11 home game against the Baltimore Ravens after Carolina downgraded him from questionable to out Saturday, as ESPN's Adam Schefter reported. Carolina kept Brooks on injured reserve after he practiced in full Friday for the third straight day. He had been limited in Thursday and Friday practices before Week 10. He aggravated the groin injury against the Atlanta Falcons in Week 2 and returned to practice on Nov. 11. Brooks topped out at six touches in his two September appearances. Etienne had seven touches over the past two games, while Chuba Hubbard had 52, including nine catches. That split limits Brooks'…

items.h: Jonathon Brooks Unlikely to Have Meaningful Role if Activated
items.s: Carolina Panthers running back Jonathon Brooks (abdomen) has been on the injured reserve since after Week 2, and he only touched the ball 11 times in 2026 prior to his IR stint. Brooks put in limited practices before Week 10, but was ultimately not activated from IR. This week, he has been a full participant in each practice and is listed as questionable on the final injury report. Head coach Dave Canales said that he believes Brooks will be ready to play in Week 11. However, other variables have come into play affecting Brooks' activation from the IR. Despite potentially being ready to play, Brooks may remain on IR for Week 11. If Brooks is activated and suits up, he will slot in behind…
Jonathon Brooks is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens. Brooks practiced in full all three days this week. He is trending towards being activated from injured reserve.

Brooks (groin) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens, Joe Person of The Athletic reports. Brooks remains on injured reserve, so the questionable tag suggests Carolina at least may activate him ahead of Sunday's contest. If he's cleared to play, the running back would be in line to make his first appearance since Week 2, though he's no real threat to Chuba Hubbard's standing as the Panthers' lead back.

Carolina Panthers running back Jonathon Brooks (abdomen) is being listed as questionable to play in Sunday's Week 11 contest at home against the Baltimore Ravens, according to Joe Person of The Athletic. Brooks returned to practice last week but was not activated from Injured Reserve for the three-point win over the division-rival New Orleans Saints. The 23-year-old returned to full practice this week, though, so he has a much better shot at playing this weekend against Baltimore, where he would be the clear backup to starter Chuba Hubbard. Brooks (groin) remained a full participant in Thursday's practice, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports. Brooks is still on injured reserve but appears to be tracking toward a Week 11 return against Baltimore on Sunday. Chuba Hubbard should remain head-and-shoulders above Brooks on the depth chart as the clear RB1 for Carolina, but the Panthers likely also want to use the rest of the season to see if Brooks can stay healthy for a stretch and produce when given opportunities. Brooks is worth adding in fantasy, but his role will need to be defined before plugging him in lineups.
Jonathon Brooks is practicing again on Thursday. Brooks continues to trend towards being activated for Sunday's game against the Ravens.

items.h: Jonathon Brooks Practices Fully Ahead of Ravens Game
items.s: Carolina Panthers running back Jonathon Brooks (groin) practiced fully Thursday, The Charlotte Observer's Mike Kaye reported. Carolina also listed him as a full participant on Wednesday's estimated report. Brooks took only scout-team reps last week after the Panthers opened his practice window on Nov. 11. Head coach Dave Canales said Wednesday he believes Brooks is ready, with activation from injured reserve still pending ahead of Sunday's game against the Baltimore Ravens. Brooks injured his groin against the Atlanta Falcons in Week 2 and went on injured reserve on Sept. 23. NFL Network reported at the time that he was set to undergo core muscle surgery. Brooks totaled 73 yards from…

Following a week of limited practice participation ahead of the team's Week 10 win over the Saints, Carolina Panthers running back Jonathon Brooks (groin) logged a full session on Wednesday and was again seen practicing on Thursday, according to beat reporter Mike Kaye. Already in his third NFL season, Brooks' early career has been defined by injury, and following an offseason of sleeper hype, he lasted only two games before a groin injury landed him on injured reserve yet again. After his practice window was opened in Week 10, a Week 11 return appears imminent, and while he is unlikely to see enough work to forge his own fantasy relevance, his presence introduces uncertainty and the…

items.h: Jonathon Brooks (core) logs full practice Wednesday
items.s: Jonathon Brooks was a full participant in practice on Wednesday. Brooks had his practice window opened last week. He'll have a chance to be activated for Sunday's game against the Ravens.

Brooks (groin) was a full participant at Wednesday's walkthrough. Brooks was listed similarly last Wednesday before capping the week with back-to-back limited practices and receiving a doubtful tag for Week 10 action. He then was downgraded to out before this past Sunday's game at New Orleans. Brooks is seeking a return from injured reserve, where he's resided since after Week 2 due to core muscle surgery.

items.h: Panthers Believe Jonathon Brooks Will Be Ready to Return from IR in Week 11
items.s: Carolina Panthers head coach Dave Canales said that he believes running back Jonathon Brooks (abdomen) will be ready to return from Injured Reserve in Week 11 against the Baltimore Ravens, per Nick Carboni of WCNC Charlotte. Brooks has been sidelined since Week 2 after undergoing core muscle surgery. The 23-year-old has had an injury-ravaged NFL career to this point, appearing in just five games across three seasons since being selected by the Panthers in the second round of the 2024 draft. Upon his return, Brooks could take some work away from Panthers RB1 Chuba Hubbard, who has averaged 21.3 touches per game in 2026. Brooks is unlikely to play a fantasy-relevant role right away, but he…

items.h: Jonathon Brooks Worth Adding as He Nears a Return
items.s: Carolina running back Jonathon Brooks (core) has still not returned to the field, but he's worth adding in some more fantasy leagues as that time nears. The running back has missed seven straight games now, allowing Chuba Hubbard to serve as the workhorse back in the meantime. Brooks managed to practice a bit before Week 10, but was eventually ruled out. His next chance to return will be Week 11 against the Ravens. Brooks got in the first two games of the season, tallying 30 rushing yards across nine carries and 43 receiving yards across two receptions and three targets. Brooks should be somewhat involved offensively when he's back on the field, and that gives him some deep-league fantasy…
Jonathon Brooks has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Saints. Brooks had his practice window opened by the Panthers. He was limited in practice throughout the week.

Brooks (groin) has been downgraded from doubtful to out for Sunday's game against the Saints, Joe Person of The Athletic reports. Brooks ended Week 10 prep with back-to-back limited practices, but he was tagged as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Panthers. The third-year running back is not quite fully recovered from a groin injury that landed him on IR in late September, so his next chance to suit up is Week 11 against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 22. Trevor Etienne, AJ Dillon and Anthony Tyus will continue to operate in rotational backfield roles behind Chuba Hubbard while Brooks is sidelined.

items.h: Jonathon Brooks Downgraded to Out vs. Saints
items.s: The Carolina Panthers have officially ruled running back Jonathon Brooks (abdomen) out for the Week 10 game on Sunday against the division-rival New Orleans Saints, according to Joe Person of The Athletic. Brooks was listed as doubtful on Friday's final injury report, but after returning to practice this week, he will remain on Injured Reserve for another week. The oft-injured 23-year-old will now not be eligible to return for the Panthers until Week 11 at home against the Baltimore Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 22. Jonathon Brooks is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Saints. Brooks had his practice window opened this week. He is unlikely to be activated for Sunday.

Brooks (groin) is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game at New Orleans after being limited in practice throughout the week, Kassidy Hill of the Panthers' official site reports. Brooks remains on injured reserve and isn't likely to be activated by the 4:00 p.m. ET deadline Saturday. Carolina Panthers running back Jonathon Brooks (abdomen), who remains on Injured Reserve, is listed as doubtful to play in Week 10 on Sunday against the division-rival New Orleans Saints, according to Joe Person of The Athletic. Brooks took scout-team reps at practice on Wednesday and Thursday but was erroneously listed as a full participant. Instead, Brooks was limited, and he is unlikely to come off IR on Saturday and play on Sunday in New Orleans. It means that he most likely will not return from IR until next week at home against the Baltimore Ravens in Week 11.
